_comment: Loaded automatically only when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Testing (AssemblySetup.cs sets this before any WebApplicationFactory-based test runs). Deliberately the ONLY appsettings.*.json that still carries ConnectionStrings/Authentication/Smtp/TemplateLibrary: it lets integration tests boot the real, fully-wired pipeline deterministically, without interactively completing the Setup Wizard first. Same placeholder credentials that used to live in the main appsettings.json — not real secrets, and not used outside this environment. See Program.cs's isConfigured check and the 'Removing appsettings.json secrets' ADR.
